Decision recorded: docs/adr/0019-failure-envelope-field-tiers.md. Traced each field against fetcher_response.py/models.py: status+retrieval_incomplete are genuinely orthogonal axes (verdict vs completeness), NOT one implying the other -- several status:failed terminals (gone_confirmed, operator_error, unreachable) deliberately leave retrieval_incomplete False, so collapsing them would silently lose that ADR-0009-relevant distinction. tier is already free on the modal raw-tier path (deviation-pruned) and is a real provenance signal. diagnostics_summary IS the redundant one -- a key=value re-serialization of narrative's exact same four inputs (tier_used, final_verdict, gate_subsystem, total_ms), built for log/grep tooling not an agent-facing channel -- decided to move it behind debug=True; narrative stays as the one caller-visible prose summary. headings is NOT generally redundant with content_md as the bd note worried: content_md is dropped on a failed fetch but headings is not gated by _FAILURE_ONLY_FIELDS, so on exactly the failure path this issue is about, headings can be the ONLY structural signal left -- no cut, per the issue's own 'measure before cutting' instruction. Implementation (moving diagnostics_summary to the debug group) filed as a2web-7bj.12, a follow-up bead as the AC specifies -- not applied here since it changes the response envelope shape (Ask-First).

Implemented per ADR-0019. diagnostics_summary moved to failure-AND-debug: joins the debug group (regrouped under the nested debug{} object) AND still requires status != ok, stricter than its debug-only siblings which show regardless of status. Internal model attribute (FetchResponse.diagnostics_summary / AskResponse.diagnostics_summary) stays always-populated for internal callers (eval harness reads it unconditionally, confirmed no call site needed changing) -- only the wire serializer (_omit_empty / _envelope_discipline) applies the gate, via a new internal-only wire_debug: bool = Field(exclude=True) field set at construction from fc.inputs.debug / ask's debug param (mirrors the existing structured_grounded/small_page_confirmed exclude=True pattern). narrative is unaffected (still failure-only, no debug requirement) per ADR-0019. Updated fetch-response + ask-response specs (split the combined narrative+diagnostics_summary Requirement in two), the ask tool's debug field description, and re-blessed the wire contract (make bless-wire SLUG=diagnostics-summary-debug-gate) -- delta is exactly diagnostics_summary dropping from 2 failure captures + the debug field description text, self-documented in tests/contracts/DELTAS.md. 6 new/updated tests across ask_response/fetch_response/adr0009_wire_signals covering: failure+no-debug omits it, failure+debug carries it under debug{}, success+debug still omits it. gains a new zero-overlap check between the caller's ask and served LISTING ITEM titles
(record_set.records[].heading_text) -- not the page's own <title>, which conventionally echoes

Design: all-or-nothing across the served set (flags only when EVERY item misses, not a partial
threshold -- avoids the false-positive tuning risk the bd issue itself flagged); a small, fixed,
English-only operator-word list (price/stock/vs/compare/...) stripped from the query side only,
since a2web's own query convention is English regardless of the page's language; a query with
nothing substantive left after stripping is skipped, not flagged. Plain stdlib normalization
(casefold + NFKD), no stemming, no new dependency. Reuses the exact downgrade-only confidence-cap
+ operator-hint mechanism a2web-axb established for served_url_differs -- new hint code
query_title_mismatch, same shape, independent (both can fire together).

Explicitly out of scope (Non-Goals in design.md): the confusable-model-variant shape on a SINGLE
product page (Lenovo 15AKP10 asked, 15IRX10 served) -- there are no listing item titles to check
against on a detail page, and the signal there is inherently partial-overlap (both strings share
"Lenovo"), a materially harder, higher-false-positive-risk problem than exact zero-overlap. Its
own design pass and bead if pursued.
